profile.headline: Full Stack Engineer | Passionate About Innovation & Scalable Tech | Seeking New Opportunities
profile.summary:
🚀 Software Engineer | Full Stack Developer | Retail & E-Commerce Tech Expert 

I am a Full Stack Software Engineer with a passion for building scalable, user-friendly, and high-impact digital solutions. With experience in retail, e-commerce, and payment systems, I thrive at the intersection of technology and business, helping companies streamline operations and enhance customer experiences.

What I Bring to the Table:
✅ Retail & E-Commerce Expertise – I helped build a mobile point-of-sale system that replaced Shopify for a national retail brand, improving transaction processing, inventory management, and financing.
✅ Full Stack Development – Skilled in front-end and back-end technologies, I create robust and scalable applications that drive business efficiency.
✅ Collaboration & Problem-Solving – Experienced in working across teams to align technical solutions with business needs, ensuring smooth project execution.

I am currently seeking new opportunities where I can contribute my skills in software development, retail tech, and gamified marketing to build innovative and impactful solutions. If you're looking for a driven engineer to help shape the future of digital commerce and customer engagement, let's connect!

📩 Let’s talk! I’m open to networking, collaboration, and job opportunities.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Designed and developed core features for Purple’s Mobile Point-of-Sale (mPOS) system, used across all retail locations in the U.S., enabling seamless transactions and enhancing customer experience.

Key Contributions & Achievements:
✅ Led the development of a scalable, high-performance POS microservices architecture using Node.js and AWS Lambda.
✅ Built and optimized RESTful APIs for seamless integration with CommerceTools and retail systems.
✅ Enhanced search capabilities by implementing efficient query structures, allowing agents to quickly locate orders.
✅ Integrated Clover payment processing, enabling customers to use multiple payment methods per transaction.
✅ Developed a ChargeAfter financing integration, replacing Affirm and enabling seamless loan processing, ensuring orders were properly funded at checkout.
✅ Launched return & exchange workflows, automating processes between CommerceTools & NetSuite, reducing customer service workload.
✅ Collaborated cross-functionally with retail teams, e-commerce teams, and integrations engineers to ensure smooth deployment of new features.

Tech Stack:
🔹 Frontend: React, TypeScript, Material UI
🔹 Backend: Node.js, TypeScript, AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, CloudWatch)
🔹 Tools: Jira, Confluence, Git
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · TypeScript · React.js · AWS Lambda · Node.js · Agile Application Development · Jira

positions.description:

positions.description:

positions.description:

•	Properly maintained and operated heavy equipment to complete digs and installations
•	Ensured that all digs and installations met specifications required for construction 
•	Followed proper safety procedures for working with and around heavy equipment
